description: State Ministry of Home Affairs - Additional Bank Holidays for the Year - 2022
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Holiday Act, No. 29 of 1971, declaring specific dates as additional bank holidays. It is a legal/regulatory action that modifies existing legislation by adding to the statutory schedule of holidays, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal amendments and statutory instruments.
